effects.does: Clicking Copy starts cloning the current project.

effects.leadsTo: Project creation screen, then the cloned project's details after success.

effects.does: Clicking the copy icon copies the associated displayed value to the clipboard.

effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara asks Clara to analyze the current event data.
